terminal_plugin_description: Opens terminals beside a conversation, on this computer and on SSH hosts. Agents can run commands in them, which you approve unless a permission, a rule or full access covers them, and cite their output.
terminal_start_failed: The terminal plugin could not read its settings. Restart Mannie, then turn the plugin on again.

match.countPlural=one: A command runs in a terminal. Turning the plugin off ends every terminal and everything it started.
match.countPlural=other: Commands run in {count: number} terminals. Turning the plugin off ends every terminal and everything it started.

terminal_commands_empty_description: Commands that you or an agent run in this terminal show here.
terminal_end_description: A command runs in it. Ending the terminal ends the command and everything it started.
terminal_plain_shell: This shell does not mark its commands, so agents cannot run commands here. You can still use it.
terminal_leave_hint_end: in the terminal to move the focus to its toolbar.
terminal_ended_exited: The terminal ended. Its shell exited with {code}.
terminal_ended_stopped: The terminal ended when the plugin turned off or Mannie quit.
terminal_ended_lost: The connection to the host was lost ({code}).
terminal_mention_not_added: The mention was not added: open the conversation's message box, or remove a mention first.

match.countPlural=one: The command's output. 1 line is left out where … stands.
match.countPlural=other: The command's output. {count: number} lines are left out where … stands.

terminal_settings_default_shell_descript: The shell that a new terminal on this computer runs when you choose none.
terminal_settings_scrollback_description: From {min} to {max}. More lines use more memory.
terminal_settings_cursor_blink_descripti: A steady cursor costs less on battery.
terminal_settings_renderer_automatic: Automatic: the graphics card where it has hardware acceleration
terminal_settings_screen_reader_descript: Screen readers read the terminal's output. It makes terminals a little slower.
terminal_tool_busy: A command ran in the terminal, so this one was not typed.
terminal_tool_owner_typing: You were typing in the terminal, so the command was not typed.
terminal_tool_changed: The terminal changed since the approval, so the command was not typed.
terminal_tool_plain: The terminal's shell does not mark its commands, so the command was not typed.
terminal_tool_not_opened: The terminal could not be opened.
terminal_tool_still_running: The command did not end after Ctrl+C and may still run.
terminal_tool_interrupted: The command ran past its wait and was interrupted with Ctrl+C.
terminal_mention_not_found: The terminal no longer has this command.
terminal_error_block_not_found: The terminal no longer has this command.
terminal_error_folder_invalid: The project's folder does not exist. Check the project, then try again.
terminal_error_host_not_found: No plugin offers this host now. Turn its plugin on, then try again.
terminal_error_host_unavailable: The host does not open terminals now. Check it in its plugin's settings.
terminal_error_open_failed: The terminal could not be opened. The log has the cause.
terminal_error_shell_not_listed: This shell is not one of this computer's shells.
terminal_error_storage_failed: The terminal settings could not be read or stored. Try again.
terminal_error_terminal_not_found: This conversation has no such terminal.
terminal_error_too_many: As many terminals run as are allowed. End one, then try again.
